user.title: ACB access controller
user.description: How would you like to add the controller?

discovery.title: Controllers found
discovery.description: Select the controller to add. The number of doors is derived from the serial number and can be changed later in the options.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter the IP address and the serial number printed on the controller.

doors.title: Number of doors
doors.description: How many doors does controller {serial} drive? The serial number suggests the preselected answer.

abort.no_devices_found: No controller answered the broadcast. Check that Home Assistant is on the same subnet, then use manual setup.

init.title: Communication settings
init.description: Pushing makes the controller send records as they happen. A controller stores a single receiving server, so enabling it replaces any other software currently registered. Clock synchronisation rewrites the controller clock at each daylight-saving transition, which the hardware cannot handle on its own.

data.push_port: Local UDP port to receive records

open_door.name: Open door
open_door.description: Sends the remote open-door command to the controller.

set_door_mode.name: Set door mode
set_door_mode.description: Changes the control mode of a door. The mode is stored in the controller.

delay.name: Open delay
delay.description: Relay release duration in seconds. Left unchanged when omitted.

sync_time.name: Synchronise clock
sync_time.description: Writes Home Assistant's current local time to the controller.

discover.name: Discover controllers
discover.description: Broadcasts a discovery request on the local network.

timeout.name: Listen timeout
timeout.description: How long to listen for replies, in seconds.

options.door_contact: Door contact — whether the leaf actually moved
